title: Ellington and unemployment tax
summary: Brown says Ellington did not pay unemployment tax, so Tizol could not collect.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Do you know that when the -- the unemployment situation came in that none of the band, when they were off, could get unemployment, because Ellington had refused to pay the unemployment tax. Now that can be looked up in the Government's records.
He never paid any unemployment for his men.
Wasn't he required to by law?

He was but he was always running and always being excused by the biggies. And one very concrete example of that was when Tizol was out of the band he went down to get the unemployment, you know, by the week --
-- couldn't get it because they told him that there was none paid in for him and they just let it go, nobody (never) brought a charge. So --
-- all of these things are just too bad.
